title: Your Cal.com to Call Booked Pipeline System

sections.label: 1 - A CALL GETS BOOKED
sections.note: Zapier does the handoff. When a call is booked in Cal.com, the Booking Created Zap creates or updates the contact in GoHighLevel, fills Call Time and Call Notes, and adds the call-booked tag. That tag starts everything below and puts the lead in the Call Booked Pipeline.

sections.label: 2 - THE OWNER HEARS FIRST
sections.note: You get a text the moment it lands and an email with everything from the booking form, so you walk into the call prepared.

sections.label: 3 - BEFORE THE CALL
sections.note: Cal.com already sends the confirmation and the reminders, so nothing here repeats them. One short email asks what they want from the call, then the workflow keeps watch for a cancel. The close-out task keeps cards from sitting in Call Booked; Showed and No Show are the other two stages.

sections.label: 4 - IF THEY CANCEL
sections.note: A second Zap on Cal.com Booking Cancelled adds call-cancelled. The goal pulls the contact here from wherever they are, the card moves to Cancelled, and they get one easy way to rebook. A reschedule only updates Call Time, so the card stays put.

nodes.label: 2 - Clear an Old call-cancelled Tag
nodes.notes: Someone who cancelled before and books again starts clean, so a second cancel is still caught by the goal.

nodes.label: 3 - Add the Lead to Call Booked Pipeline
4 - Text the Owner the New Booking

params.to: the contact's assigned user, and if none is assigned, all users
params.message: New call booked: {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}} for {{contact.call_time}}. It is in the Call Booked Pipeline. Details are in your email.

nodes.label: 5 - Email the Owner the Booking Details

params.to: the contact's assigned user, and if none is assigned, all users
params.subject: Call booked: {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}}, {{contact.call_time}}
params.message: {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}} booked a call for {{contact.call_time}}. Email {{contact.email}}. Phone {{contact.phone}}. What they wrote on the booking form: {{contact.call_notes}}. The opportunity is in Call Booked Pipeline, stage Call Booked.

nodes.label: 6 - Email the Lead One Prep Question

params.subject: Quick question before our call, {{contact.first_name}}
params.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, thanks for booking time with {{location.name}}. Your calendar invite already has the details. One question so I can come prepared: what is the one thing you most want to walk away with from our call? Just hit reply. {{user.first_name}}

nodes.notes: Not a reminder. Cal.com sends those. This is the one message that makes the call better.

nodes.label: 7 - Wait 14 Days While the Call Is Upcoming
nodes.notes: Keeps the contact in the workflow so the goal can catch a cancel. Match it to how far ahead the Cal.com event type lets people book.

nodes.label: 8 - Task: Close Out the Card After the Call

params.title: Move {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}} to Showed or No Show if the card is still in Call Booked

nodes.label: 9 - Goal: Call Cancelled in Cal.com
nodes.notes: The Booking Cancelled Zap adds call-cancelled. Whenever that lands, even mid-wait, the contact jumps straight here. Anyone who reaches this step without cancelling simply ends.

nodes.label: 11 - Remove the call-booked Tag
nodes.notes: So a rebooking adds the tag fresh and starts this workflow again.

nodes.label: 12 - Email the Lead a Link to Rebook

params.subject: Want to pick a new time, {{contact.first_name}}?
params.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, no problem on cancelling. If you still want to talk, grab any open time here: {{custom_values.booking_link}}. If the timing is just not right, reply and let me know. {{user.first_name}}

params.to: the contact's assigned user, and if none is assigned, all users
params.message: {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}} cancelled their call for {{contact.call_time}}. The card is in Cancelled and a rebook link went out by email.

contact.call_notes: Want to see how to stop losing leads after the first call
